answer: Each fake identity must plant one orchard row on a distinct altitude band of the knoll, drawing from the same summit spring: the k-th clone pays 2^(k-1) summit stones, so N fakes cost 2^N - 1 in total, 1,023 for 10 and over a million for 20. Two rows planted on the same band graft onto one rootstock and both wither, so clones cannot share a band to split the cost.
